answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 148454 Country: Pakistan Title: If a non-Mahram sees the female’s awrah, (hair, ankle or wrist), it nullifies her wudhu. Is this correct? Question: If a non-Mahram sees the female’s awrah, (hair, ankle or wrist), it nullifies her wudhu. Is this correct? Answer ID: 148454 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 328/309/N=5/1438) Wudhu does not break if one sees the knee, back or hair of any strange woman. However, it is unlawful to see it or let others to see. Both should avoid it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
